issue: Cites 'Decree No. (34) of 2013' (should be 43/2013) and says the 20% band applies to rents that 'exceed the average by more than 40%'; Decree 43/2013 Art. 1(e) applies it where the rent is more than 40% LESS than the average.
States that 'according to the law, it is mandatory to collect a security deposit'; Law 26/2007 Art. 20 says the Landlord 'may obtain' a deposit (and sets no maximum).

Says a new owner keeps tenants only 'if the new owner wants to', 'can only increase the rent', and may evict for own/relative use by asking in writing. Art. 28: a fixed-term lease survives the transfer of ownership; Art. 25(2)(c) (am.): own-use eviction only on expiry, with 12 months' notice via notary public or registered mail and proof of no suitable alternative property. The answer appears to be adapted from a non-Dubai source.
